title: W33 augmentation middle and Levi radical 19-space
purpose: Determine by explicit native-GAP intertwiners whether ker(A+I)/im(A+I) on the W33 point augmentation module is the distinguished 19-dimensional Levi radical layer from Pass4865, and resolve its 14+5 submodule structure rather than relying on a dimension coincidence.
outcome: The W33 middle is split 5+14, while the Levi 19-space is the nonsplit extension 14.5. They are not isomorphic. Unique rank-14 and rank-5 maps form a square-zero two-periodic complex, with the reverse map restored under the outer sign twist.
boundary: Equal dimension does not identify the two 19-spaces. This finite F3 theorem does not split the Levi extension, equate the point and line carriers, or imply a continuum, hardware, security, or particle claim.
